text: One rule matters more than any button in this lesson: sharing a report also shares its underlying semantic model.
Three link types, three outcomes. People in your organization, for anyone internal. Specific people, for named individuals or guests. People with existing access, which grants nothing new at all.
Every link also carries two optional permissions. Reshare lets the recipient pass it along further. Build is the bigger one — it lets them create entirely new reports from your semantic model.
Manage permissions shows everyone with direct access in one place — grant more, review pending requests, or remove someone entirely.
Hiding a table doesn't stop someone from seeing its data — only row- and object-level security actually restrict it. Lesson 73 packages all of this into something bigger: an app.
